summary: End-to-end regression of the new individual Success Story SEO landing pages (iteration 5). All 13 backend pytest cases pass against the public preview URL and all 8 frontend E2E scenarios pass via Playwright. The refactor from a hardcoded React array to a backend-served single source of truth is working correctly; search + category filters, deep-linking, related grid, 404 fallback, and bot-facing HTML render endpoints all behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/success_stories_data.py: _build() slug collision fallback (`{slug}-{id}`) is correct and 60 unique slugs verified. STORIES_BY_SLUG O(1) lookup and get_related (same-category first, then same-platform, excluding self, capped at 4) all working as documented.

seo_routes.py /api/seo/success-story/{slug} returns proper 404 via HTTPException, and /api/seo/render/success-story/{slug} returns 404 + <meta name='robots' content='noindex, follow'> for unknown slugs as required.
Sitemap returns 60 <loc> entries, all pointing to https://www.incomeonline.info/success-stories/{slug}, with correct application/xml content-type and Cache-Control header.

Render endpoints emit unique <title>, meta description, canonical, Article JSON-LD, breadcrumb nav, and internal links to /, /success-stories, /platforms/{platform-slug} and /donate — all good for SEO.
Frontend SuccessStoryDetail correctly sets noindex on error via useSEO({ noindex: error }), and the 404 fallback card with data-testid='back-to-stories' navigates back to /success-stories.

SuccessStories list page fetches once on mount with cancellation guard; search & category filters operate client-side on the fetched 60-item array — verified 60 -> 1 (Sarah) and 60 -> 7 (Freelancing).

Minor nit (non-blocking): /api/seo/success-story/{slug} does case-normalisation in get_by_slug but the React route preserves case from URL. Behaviour is fine as-is because all generated slugs are lowercase; just note that a mixed-case URL like /success-stories/Sarah-M-Upwork will 404 from API.

Minor nit (non-blocking): The 'See {platform}' button on the detail page links to /platforms/{slugified-platform}, which depends on the platforms DB (empty in preview). Intentional per problem statement — works in production.
test_credentials: N/A — public endpoints, no auth needed.
seed_data_creation: None. Data is read-only from backend/success_stories_data.py (Python module).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend source of truth for stories lives in /app/backend/success_stories_data.py (STORIES, get_all, get_by_slug, get_related). Slug format = slugify('{name}-{platform}') lowercase, hyphens, e.g. 'sarah-m-upwork', 'james-k-youtube', 'rob-percival-udemy'. List endpoint: GET /api/seo/success-stories (returns {stories, count:60}). Single: GET /api/seo/success-story/{slug} returns {story, related:[..<=4]}. Bot render: GET /api/seo/render/success-story/{slug} and /api/seo/render/success-stories. Sitemap: GET /api/seo/success-stories-sitemap.xml (60 <loc>). Frontend route: /success-stories/:slug -> SuccessStoryDetail.jsx with data-testid story-name / story-link-{slug} / read-full-story-{slug} / related-story-{slug} / back-to-stories. Note: preview MongoDB has 0 platforms, so /api/seo/render/home shows '0+ platforms' and /platforms/{slug} pages are empty — expected per problem statement; production has 185.
rca_of_the_issue: No issues found. Frontend Console shows two 404s during the negative-path test (deliberate bad-slug navigation), which is expected behaviour — backend returns 404 and the React detail page renders the 'Success story not found' card with back-to-stories button.
